notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Fixed bug in which after getting the dash ability in 3-MottaSua and dying in the blood puddle, dash no longer worked. Besides fixing the actual bug the blood puddle itself has been removed, as the gap still requires the use of the dash ability.
 Fixed incorrect bounceable flags in several spinning razors in LOST-3

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7
notes.notes: Fixed bug in which Primal Fireballs were immediately destroyed when spawning too close to the floor/walls.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6
notes.notes: Added the possibility to hit Pluma Serpis' head when it's in the firing laser sweep stage. Hitting this head still counts for the achievement "Headshots only, please".

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5
notes.notes:
This patch is mainly aimed to fix bugs and balance parameters that were plaguing the Pluma Serpis encounter, making it inconsistent and frustrating to deal with.


 Fixed pesky bug in Pluma Serpis in which the boss inconsistently started new stages without finishing the last one.
 Lowered the probability of the middle flame razors in the Razor Rain stage of Pluma Serpis to provide a more uniform experience when retrying the encounter.
 Decreased amount of modules that appear in the first stage of Pluma Serpis to make the stage slightly shorter.
 Tweaked the module pattern in the first stage of Pluma Serpis to balance the stage and avoid getting too many hittable modules in a row.
 Adjusted 2-8 and 3-6 to avoid certain situations in which the player could get stuck because of Button Spikes, forcing the player to die/restart in order to retry the puzzle and advance in the level.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.4
notes.notes: Fixed bug in which player could get hurt/killed while aiming Primal Fireball. Since guns are disabled during this state, this caused an issue in which they stayed disabled when respawning and caused a softlock.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed Primal Fireball staying still if not holding the joystick
 Fixed several Flame Spikes hitboxes in 4-2 and LOST levels
 Adjusted tile positions in 1-9
 Made static gun activation in 3-3 near save point not depend on player position

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Extended hurtbox active time in Ata Saga when going inside the wall to take advantage of last couple of bullets
 Fixed incorrect hitbox sizes in 4-9
 Added extra save points in 1-7, 1-8 and 1-9 to ease difficulty ramping
 Added extra spike in 1-9 to access previous Glyphets

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes: Small level adjustments to ease difficulty ramping in initial levels

notes.title: Quetzal Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hi all! We are extremely excited to finally release the new demo version of Quetzal’s Call.

During the past few months, we have ported the whole game from one version to another of our game engine, Godot. Many things have changed from the original demo, including the color palette, which is the biggest difference, but the gameplay should feel as smooth as always.

A few points on what to expect:


 Includes the same levels from the old demo - with a few changes!
 We have added a new area, which includes 2 new levels
 The previous hidden levels are now “lost levels”
 You can now collect Glyphets in each level, they provide an extra challenge for those who wish to challenge themselves further
 The Steam Deck version is behaving a bit strangely, it works but the performance isn't great and some labels aren't appearing as they should. We are working on solving this!


We really look forward to hearing your thoughts! If you have any feedback, the best place to let us know is via our Discord server.

Milo & Giulia

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953670/

notes.title: Quetzal Demo Update | Including a New Level!
notes.notes:
Quetzal just got a shiny new update!

We have heard your feedback and done a few changes including bug fixes, control additions, environmental visual improvements and a brand new level!

Discord Challenge

As always, we have prepared a challenge for the new hidden level that is hosted inside of our Discord, so if you would like to participate, join our server: https://discord.com/invite/RBwTHd2xW6

See below the complete changelog:

Changelog | Demo Update 0.2.5

Features


 Environment design overhaul:
1. Birds
2. Flat background procedural abstract shapes to make levels feel less empty
3. Added small waterfalls to checkpoints.
 Added vegetation elements to all the levels.
 Added several hidden rooms to the game to offer more depth and context about the game world.
 Level Select menu: levels are unlocked once you enter them for the first time.
 One new challenge level at the end of the demo.
 Added Discord and Wishlist buttons to the main menu.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed issue where double jump was cancelled after a short time. This was very noticeable in long jumps/falls.
 Fixed issue where getting hit cancelled double jump.
 Fixed rare glitch where Primal Fireball did not work because the bullet instance had been killed.


Improvements


 Added UI sound feedback for better navigation.
 Made a small light shine from the player to improve visibility.
 Implement support to aim Primal Fireball with the left joystick as well as the right one.
 Improved spike visibility to distinguish from grass.
 Increased spike hit sound effect volume to offer better auditory feedback.
 Balanced Tybso Fiba boss fight by changing his pattern slightly and adjusting max HP.
 Added “hold to skip” functionality to credits.
 Improved d-pad support, as it was skipping inputs before.
 Improved hazard glimmer algorithm to make them more visible.
 Enhanced bullet VFX for better visibility.
 Slight level design rearrangement to make experience less frustrating.


Please reach out if you have any issues or questions!
